fullContentHtml:
HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the notification for the post of Food Safety Officer (FSO). This recruitment has been issued for 45 posts. The online application process for HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Recruitment 2026 will start from 28 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 19 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 19 September 2026
  • Application Start Date : 28 September 2026
  • Last Date : 19 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 19 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, General DESM -Male : Rs. 1000/-
  • OSC, DSC, BC-A NCL, BC-B (NCL), ESM, EWS : Rs.250/-
  • PwBD (with at least 40% disability): Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.

  • Download Notification
  • Official Sarkari Result Website
  • Sarkari Result Mobile App
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Online Form 2026?

HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Online Form 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 19 October 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://sarkariresult.com.cm/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
